about: Content mapper contract, cache soundness, span-mapping, purity, cycle, and file-asset sandbox mutants.

mutants.name: cmap-spans-overlap-admitted
mutants.rule: VerifySpans requires generated intervals to be monotonically ordered and disjoint.

mutants.name: cmap-spans-companion-bounds-unchecked
mutants.rule: VerifySpans refuses out-of-range Companion indices in SpanMapping entries.

mutants.name: cmap-cache-key-includes-inline-line
mutants.rule: Inline Line and Col are excluded from contentmap cache keys so comment/line shifts preserve cache hits.

mutants.name: cmap-cache-hit-skipped
mutants.rule: A valid cached MappedErgo entry must be reused when input bytes, companions, and canonical mapper semantics match.

mutants.name: cmap-error-diag-still-parses-inline
mutants.rule: Any Error MapperDiag stops before parsing MappedErgo.Source (One mistake, one diagnostic).

mutants.name: cmap-mapper-foreign-go-allowed
mutants.rule: Content mappers cannot invoke foreign Go imports at check time.

mutants.name: cmap-mapper-tasks-allowed
mutants.rule: Content mappers cannot start tasks at check time.

mutants.name: cmap-cycle-error-dropped
mutants.from: res.Diags = append(res.Diags, diagAtNode(origin.fileIdx, origin.file, origin.expr, check.CodeType, msg))
mutants.rule: Cyclic dependencies across inline derive expansions must emit a cycle diagnostic.

mutants.name: cmap-asset-escape-allowed
mutants.from: if relErr != nil || rel == "." || strings.HasPrefix(relSlash, "..") || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
mutants.to: if false && (relErr != nil || rel == "." || strings.HasPrefix(relSlash, "..") || filepath.IsAbs(rel)) {
mutants.rule: Asset imports escaping the module root must be refused.

mutants.name: cmap-inspect-mappers-omits-source
mutants.rule: ergo inspect mappers displays the generated Ergo source for each mapped asset or derive.
